title: Quenched Smoky Tunisian Lamb Grill
description: A fragrant lamb dish grilled on a cedar plank with aromatic spices, perfect for a quiet date night.

ingredients.name: boneless lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: trimmed and cut into 2 cm cubes

ingredients.name: cedar plank
ingredients.notes: soaked in water for 30 min before use

instructions: Soak the cedar plank in water for 30 minutes.
Pat the lamb cubes dry and rub them with olive oil, coriander, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, pepper, and lemon juice until evenly coated.
Preheat an outdoor grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and place the soaked cedar plank on the grill.
Arrange the lamb cubes in a single layer on the cedar plank and cover with a lid.
Grill the lamb for 20 minutes, turning every 5 minutes for even char and smoke infusion.
Check the internal temperature; lamb should reach 145°F for medium-rare.
Remove the cedar plank from the grill and let the lamb rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Slice the lamb against the grain and drizzle with additional lemon juice if desired.
Serve with a simple side of fresh arugula tossed in olive oil and lemon.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley for a bright finish.
